purpose: Review two legacy unbounded CPE findings; this file is not consumed by any gate.
proposed_handling: Retain raw findings and their severity; permit a separate exact-identity, expiring fixed-upstream disposition for these two records only. Require zero unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL findings.

wolfi.reason: Wolfi records both as false positives because upstream fixed the vulnerable code before Wolfi packaging.

CVE-2017-5506.assessment: fix confirmed in exact upstream source

CVE-2014-9826.assessment: probable false positive supported by supplier advisories; original Debian patch-to-current-source mapping not independently completed
CVE-2014-9826.scope_caveat: Kinetra builds raw upstream sources, not Debian/Wolfi packages; distro package status alone does not prove source equivalence.

required_invariants: No scanner ignore rules, VEX filtering, database editing, severity rewriting, SBOM/CPE removal or raw report rewriting.
Only the exact two CVE IDs and exact component/source identity are eligible; no wildcard or future-version exceptions.
Any new HIGH/CRITICAL finding, changed match range, expired disposition, changed source/SBOM hash, missing evidence, or inconsistent counts fails closed.
Positive controls remain unsuppressed and must detect CVE-2026-8461, CVE-2026-86420 and CVE-2026-86421.
Original scanner exit code 2 must remain recorded; a separate verified disposition gate must reconcile raw, dispositioned and unresolved counts.
Full image smoke, Trivy vulnerability/secret scanning, source signatures, fresh database, immutable provenance and staged deployment remain mandatory.
Before activation, integrate and negatively test the same disposition rules in scanner qualification and downstream launch provenance; preserve every unrelated assertion.
